about_the_game:
Groups + Roguelike + Match-3

The hero went missing during a mission, and the demon race is about to strike again.

Your task is to find the hero as soon as possible and uncover the mastermind behind the scenes from any clues you can gather.

Demo and Release

The demo version includes :

  2 selectable characters,

  34 types of Runes

  35 types of Relics.

It also contains 6 bosses from the first two chapters, as well as a number of clues.

It supports both Chinese and English languages, and single-player operation with a keyboard and mouse.

The full version is expected to include :

  5 selectable characters

  80+ types of Runes

  100+ types of Relics

It will contain a total of 10 bosses from the complete four chapters, and more than 5 solutions along with their corresponding hidden bosses.

It supports both Chinese and English languages, and single-player operation with a keyboard and mouse.

Scavenge loot during the rescue process

The full version will feature over 100 relics and 80 runestones, with different effects obtained through combinations.

Learn character extra skills at the camp

Each of the 5 available characters has 2 initial skills and 6 enhancement skills; choose suitable ones to further boost your power.

Defeat powerful enemies

Along the way, you'll encounter various obstacles. Defeat them, find the hero, and uncover the truth.

short_description: Rescue Quest is a single-player game that combines team-building, Roguelike elements, and match-three mechanics. Hero have gone missing, and the demons is about to strike again. Your task is to find the heroes as quickly as possible and uncover the mastermind behind it all from the clues.
